notes.title: Planet Alpha Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32319527/e621c0fc25b25a35d19f42d874a371350431811e.gif[/img]
Hey community,

PLANET ALPHA has been out for almost 24 hours!

We want to say a huge thank you to everyone who’s supported us by picking up PLANET ALPHA, we hope you’re enjoying your stay.

We’re also grateful for your feedback and bug reports. This has allowed us to do some tweaks, fixes and bug removal to give you an even better gameplay experience.

You can see the full patch notes for PLANET ALPHA’s first update below:

Patch Notes for 1.0.5.1
[List][*]Players can now complete the jump near Dead Nest on the first try.
[*]Act 02, Fixed graphics on purple mushroom orbs.
[*]Sliding audio stops once a player grabs onto a ledge.
[*]Players can now trigger the activation panel in the Pyramid regardless of how late they jump. 
[*]No collision issues on the Tripod Flower Puzzle after hitting retry.
[*]Players no longer die when seeing how high they can climb up the dinosaur legs.
[*]The Other Dimension no longer darkens once the players respawns after dying.
[*]Moons and planets have been removed from background sky in Act 01.
[*]Players can no longer climb Artifact Pointers on Pictograms.
[*]Players can no longer ride on the logs/blocks by spamming crouch.
[*]Camera no longer jitters on the Bone Chandelier.
[*]The Bone Chandelier can no longer be knocked down at an angle and now destroys all the robots.
[*]Exploit has been removed on the physics of the L-Shaped which blocked progress without triggering the first TBR encounter/puzzle.
[*]Players can no longer double jump when vaulting off climbable surfaces.
[/list]
Stay tuned to the PLANET ALPHA Facebook and Twitter pages for more info!

If you have any more feedback or encounter any issues, please get in touch with us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/485030/discussions/1/]Report a Problem[/url] forum. 

Team17 Support

notes.title: PLANET ALPHA - Launch Day!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32319527/01c3e1c4618e5eb4d41f4d5cbee7411fe34dda95.png[/img]

Hey community,

It's PLANET ALPHA's launch day!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r3F1iOc3JGI

PLANET ALPHA will be going live on Steam at 6pm BST / 10am PT / 1pm ET.

We'd like to say a huge thank you to everyone who has pre-ordered PLANET ALPHA. For those who are yet to pre-order, there's still time!

[h1]Pre-purchase offer[/h1]

If you pre-order before 6pm BST today, you'll recieve a 10% discount off of the full game price, the PLANET ALPHA original soundtrack and digital art book!

[b]*UPDATE*[/b] Pre-orders will now also come with a free copy of Worms Armageddon!

[h1]Launch offer[/h1]

At 6pm BST, the pre-purchase offer will end. It will be replaced by a new, limited time offer. Those that purchase the game on launch will receive a free Steam copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/217200/Worms_Armageddon/]Worms Armageddon[/url]!

[h1]Launch stream[/h1]

To celebrate the launch of PLANET ALPHA, we'll be hosting a livestream at 5pm BST when the game launches. 

You'll be able to watch it here on Steam, so stop by and discover the first hour of PLANET ALPHA, ask us your questions and join the fun.

[h1]Beyond launch[/h1]

We're incredibly excited to see PLANET ALPHA launch and look forward to hearing about your adventures as you solve the mysteries of PLANET ALPHA.

We'll be here on the Steam forums, taking on board your feedback and chatting all things PLANET ALPHA, but you'll also be able to find us on the official [url=https://twitter.com/PLANETALPHA]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/planetalpha/]Facebook[/url] accounts.

Welcome to PLANET ALPHA!

notes.title: Introducing PLANET ALPHA
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32319527/dac43c8a6eeab968f1be6d54074da5ba61956e04.png[/img]

Prepare for arrival to PLANET ALPHA on Steam in 2018!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9S1l6S4kgwE

PLANET ALPHA is an atmospheric side-scrolling platform adventure game. Combining exploration, creative puzzles, stealth mechanics and a unique art style to create an unforgettable experience.

You awake on a strange alien world that is home to many mysterious, exotic flora and fauna. As you explore the world around you, you’ll uncover the ability to rotate and control the planet. Is this world really as tranquil and serene as it first appears and what more will you discover?
[list]
[*]Injured, alone and stranded you venture across this foreign land, navigating beautiful and varied terrain as you try to stay alive.

[*]The world of PLANET ALPHA is affected by the solar cycle, and as you progress you’ll discover a unique gift – you can manipulate the time of day and use it to your advantage.

[*]Explore a unique world and piece together your story. What will you discover on PLANET ALPHA?
[/list]
PLANT ALPHA is a work of passion from Denmark based independent developer, Adrian Lazar.

To stay in the loop for all things PLANET ALPHA, be sure to…

Say hi and join the chatter on the Steam Forums

Follow [url=https://twitter.com/PLANETALPHA]PLANET ALPHA[/url] on Twitter

Like [url=https://www.facebook.com/planetalpha/]PLANET ALPHA[/url] on Facebook 

Follow [url=https://twitter.com/Team17Ltd]Team17[/url] on Twitter

Chat on our [url=https://discord.gg/team17]official Discord[/url]

Those attending PAX East in April will be able to get an early hands on of PLANET ALPHA, so if you see us come and say hi!
